source.rights: Proprietary source media; direct integration/upload request is not open redistribution permission.

scope: Correct replacement for D32 previously misidentified as Ch’en the Holungday. No D27 or other defender source changed.
limitations: Full original Torappu managers are not executed.
Explicit cardinal rotation_z geometry inputs are captured before projection; no post-projection image rotation used.
Original FxUVRotation matrices on head mesh nodes are not reconstructed; those nodes retain original serialized material values.
Six original trail materials are rendered with original colour gradients and width curves on explicit timed history meshes to compensate for the synchronous Editor clock.
Runtime trail composite is bent to real path history; partial-life texture stretching and UV loop phase are adaptations, not original manager equivalence.

trailContract.note: Derived from complete original local TRS hierarchy at its serialized direction=identity. Positions remain source effect-root XYZ, before actual projectile direction/model scaling. No guessed tip offset.

uvRotationShaderContract.inputs: Each uniform is packed2x2 matrix, not radians/degrees. uvST=uv*ST.xy+ST.zw; centered=uvST-.5; rot=(dot(centered,R.xz),dot(centered,R.yw))+.5; enable only if_HG_UV_ROTATION>.5; frac(speed*_Time.y) added after rotation.
uvRotationShaderContract.controllerAngleConversion: Original FxUVRotation serialized fields use90/270 degrees. Managed controller method was not executed or decompiled, so packed matrix sign convention not claimed.
uvRotationShaderContract.appliesTo: No FxUVRotation script on six TrailRenderer nodes; separate wenli01/02/04 mesh nodes have it. Do not transfer their controller angle settings onto these trails.

runtimeCalibration.headGroundDepth: All four original projected heads use real ground-anchor depth after same-frame D3D11 comparison; source pixels/PPU/pivot and directions untouched.
runtimeCalibration.gpuRegression: artifacts/chen3-remake/play-final.xml: four directions, projected-vs-upright visible pixels 1987/738,1699/536,1648/680,1455/465.
runtimeCalibration.talent: Original timer creates buff_start01 and Shield02 with true gain/heal; Shield01 follows actual evade-ready state. Consuming evade creates no extra effect.
runtimeCalibration.scope: No claim of full original client pixel equality; original UV controller, trail texture lifecycle and exact original manager callback teardown retain documented limits.
